lead.headline: Sam Houston wins at Boise State by 14 and tops the rankings at 3-4
lead.deck: The Bearkats covered as 12-point underdogs and rate best in the league. Missouri State is 5-0 and rates ninth.
body: Sam Houston went to Boise State as a 12-point underdog and won 83-69. A 19-0 run late in the first half did it, and Aidan McDowell led the Bearkats with 19 while Yoda Oke added 18. Four nights later they lost 80-73 at Washington State as 5.5-point underdogs. The record says 3-4. Our model says 89th in the country, plus-9.3 points per 100 possessions, the best rating in Conference USA. The power rankings agree and moved Sam Houston from second to first.

At the other end of that argument sits Missouri State. The Bears are 5-0, the only unbeaten team in the league, after beating Drake 67-65 as 3.5-point home underdogs. Trey Williams Jr. had 21 points, five rebounds and four assists. Our model has them 256th and ninth of ten in the league, and the power rankings have them ninth too. Undefeated and unconvinced.

Western Kentucky made the move of the week, from fifth to second. The Hilltoppers won 82-68 at Richmond as 1-point favorites, with Teagan Moore scoring 22 and Sharron Young going for 17, seven rebounds and six assists, then beat George Washington 86-78 as 3-point favorites. They are 96th in our model, second in the league.

FIU went the other way, from first to fifth. The Panthers beat Long Beach State 79-75 as 8-point favorites without covering, beat Southern Utah 81-66 behind Trey Beamer's 31 points and six assists, and then lost 92-88 at home to Arkansas State as 2-point favorites.

The league went 13-11 and split the lines 12-12. New Mexico State had the roughest week, losing three home games: 84-69 to UTEP, 84-79 to Robert Morris and 69-68 to Ohio as a 5-point favorite. The Aggies are 1-6.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three road trips worth the drive
body: **Western Kentucky at Illinois, Friday, 6 p.m.** No line yet. The Hilltoppers have won two straight, by 14 and by 8, and now get a road test the model can actually learn from.
**Liberty at UNC Wilmington, Saturday, 3 p.m.** No line yet. Liberty is 127th in our model, UNCW 139th and 6-1. The Flames need it after losing to Richmond and Princeton this week.

**Tennessee Tech at Middle Tennessee, Tuesday, 7:30 p.m.** No line yet. The Golden Eagles are the SoCon's top-rated team at 108th. Middle Tennessee is 6-2 and won 77-76 at Southern Illinois as a 4-point underdog.

notes.headline: Delaware's shootout
notes.body: The Blue Hens won 97-92 at Cal State Northridge as 8-point underdogs. DeShawn Harris-Smith had 27 points, six rebounds and seven assists, and Chuck Bailey III scored 26. Two nights later they lost 85-48 at UCLA.

notes.headline: Liberty's week
notes.body: After a 71-68 win over Rhode Island as 1.5-point underdogs, the Flames lost 92-88 to Richmond as 1-point favorites and 79-72 to Princeton as 3.5-point favorites. Eli Sancomb had 25 points and nine rebounds against Richmond.

notes.headline: Middle Tennessee by a point
notes.body: Quintero Barnett scored 24 and Landyn Colyer had 18 points and 10 rebounds in a 77-76 win at Southern Illinois. The Blue Raiders also won 69-59 at Indiana State after losing 85-76 at home to Temple.

notes.headline: Circle it: Jacksonville State at UC Davis
notes.body: Thursday, 8 p.m. ET on FloSports. The Gamecocks are 2-point favorites and our model makes it 5.8. The total is 140.
